criteria.C1: label-free arm: the median over its three seeds of the median over the 448 held-out (member, level) pairs of |F_pred / F*(e_pred) - 1| is at most 0.05
criteria.C2: label-free arm: the median over its three seeds of the 90th percentile over the same pairs of |F_pred / F*(e_pred) - 1| is at most 0.10
criteria.incomplete: INCOMPLETE while a label-free seed has neither predictions nor a non-finite stop
criteria.infinite_pairs: a pair whose reference solve at the predicted end displacement fails, or gives a force that is not positive, has an infinite curve error, which enters the median and the 90th percentile as such
criteria.non_finite_seed: a label-free seed whose run stopped on a non-finite loss or non-finite predictions, or whose metrics of a member fail altogether, enters the medians over seeds with infinite errors
criteria.reported_not_judged: every metric for every arm and seed; the supervised arm against the label-free one, with no winner set in advance; the tested members (Bursi and Jaspart T1 and T2 under the family's nominal laws)

label_solver.order: levels in increasing order, each from the previous level's solution

evaluation.contact_tolerance: u_x <= 1e-3 (D + delta) on the plane between the flanges, for prediction and reference alike
evaluation.force: the point (e, F) of a field, F = 4 k_s (D - e) its spring reading; judged by its distance from the reference curve in force at the predicted end displacement, F / F*(e) - 1, F*(e) from an exact solve under displacement control
metrics: F_pred / F_ref - 1 at the same D
the stress reading F_sigma = 4 grad W . v over F_ref, minus 1
certified bound 4 sqrt(2 k_s (Pi - Pi*)) / F_ref
plastic Gauss points intersection over union
evaluation.precision: float64, the reference code (fejoint.nlhex, fejoint.nlsolve) on the exported problem

family.fixed: rolled T-stub pair, quarter model; L 80 mm, one bolt row at y = 20 mm, web to H = 120 mm; M12 bolts, two washers, bearing radius 12 mm; E 210000, nu 0.3

loading.how: the web's end section rigid in x (one unknown e), joined by a linear spring to the loading device, whose displacement D is prescribed; the force on the pair F = 4 k_s (D - e)

family.steel: elastic to fy, plateau to 2% strain, linear to 1.35 fy at 15%, then E/10000; a slope of E/10000 added throughout the plastic range
family.theory: J2 deformation theory (Hencky), small strain; frictionless unilateral contact

map.on: u_x of the plane between the flanges and the separation slots of the bearing patch

model.decoder: a copy of the repository's FieldDecoder (node latent and pooled latent, two GELU layers), last layer zeroed at the start
model.features: centred RMS-normalised coordinates (3), Dirichlet flags (3), node flags (7), family parameters over their range maxima (7), loading-device displacement over D_max (1)
model.head: the end section's u_x (e) and the bolt head's three unknowns from the pooled latent (two GELU layers), last layer zeroed
model.output_scale: D + delta (mm): every nodal output, e and the head's axial unknown times it, the head's two tilts times it over the bearing radius

training.D_sampling: sqrt(D) uniform between sqrt(0.1) and sqrt(D_max) (label-free); 4 of the labelled levels without replacement (supervised)
training.batch: one instance per step with 4 end displacements; instances in a fresh random order each epoch
training.energy_loss: mean over the step's fields of log Pi (Pi > 0 for D > 0)
training.non_finite: a non-finite loss stops the run; the stop is final and is not retried
training.precision: float32 weights, activations and energy; float32 matmul precision 'highest' (no TF32)
training.schedule: cosine with linear warm-up over the first 5% of steps (the repository's)
training.supervised_loss: mean squared error of the physical displacement over (D + delta)^2
